value: Bodley guides the search to two further pieces. The quest versions can direct a class or faction branch toward one of several haunted companions; they are alternate targets from the same company history. The four accounts just heard are arranged here as memorials, not as four mandatory kills by one canonical traveler. When the missing pieces are brought together with Theldren’s top fragment, the medallion can be made whole again.
editorNote: Research status: the accessible quest and manual pages reproduce in-game evidence but are secondary mirrors. The manual is Bodley’s perspective. Alternate class/faction targets are editorially ordered and are not one canonical adventurer’s route.
